elements.title: Figure 10.—Estimated 1-Year Percent Change and 5-Year Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) in Prices of Critical Minerals
elements.content:
Chart kind: Horizontal bar chart with two sets of bars per mineral (1-year percent change and 5-year CAGR).

Axes:
- Left axis: 1-year percent change (2022 to 2023), range from -100 to 200 percent.
- Right axis: 5-year CAGR (2019 to 2023), range from -100 to 100 percent.

Legend/Explanation:
- Left bars (yellow) represent 1-year percent change.
- Right bars (black) represent 5-year CAGR.
